### [`hub/hub-cell-styles.ts`](../../components/orlando/hub/hub-cell-styles.ts)

- `HUB_CELL` _const_: The square: a fixed box with the minutes centred, tabular so columns line up.
- `HUB_CELL_BEST` _const_: The resort's shortest line that day: one ring inside the box, so the grid never shifts.
- `HUB_CELL_LAST_YEAR` _const_: A day read off last year: the dashed edge the legend names "last year".
- `EARLY_CLOSE_CORNER` _const_: The early-close mark: a small folded corner, top right, where a ticketed evening sends the day guests out early. A shape, not an icon, so the square still holds only its number.

### [`hub/hub-glance.tsx`](../../components/orlando/hub/hub-glance.tsx)

- `HubGlance` _component_: The hub's first answer: on one day, Orlando time, each resort's shortest line with its minutes and its level, and the early close where a ticketed evening follows.
- `MonthGlance` _component_: A month page's first answer: each resort's quietest dates that month with the park that has the shortest lines on them. On a month past the forecast the dates are last year's, said so in the title and never offered as picks.
